title: Argus deterministic gate result
description: Machine-readable output of the deterministic gate runner (scripts/gates.sh). The ungameable floor: the judge is never dispatched while all_green is false. Platform adapters fill in the gates they implement and mark the rest 'skip'.

target.description: The renderable unit being gated (a screen / view / page id from the spec).

gates.description: Per-gate status. 'skip' means the adapter does not implement this gate; skipped gates do not affect all_green.

token_contrast.description: Deterministic WCAG contrast over declared token pairs (check_contrast.py). Platform-agnostic.

token_compliance.description: Deterministic grep of changed source for hardcoded colors/spacing not sourced from the design system. Adapter-specific.

a11y_ids.description: Result of comparing the probe's element ids against the spec's a11y contract (a11y_assert.py).

all_green.description: True iff every implemented (non-skip) gate passed. Computed by gates.sh, never by the model.
